_readme: The time card: where he has worked, in order, no dates. Kept short on purpose (owner, 9 Nov 2026: no school history, no job-by-job detail, no early-jobs photo). The last row is always today.
title: Clocked in
lede: Where I’ve worked, in order. No dates on this card, just what each one taught me.

rows.note: Selling across a counter, one customer at a time.
Zomato Everyday, for about a year and a half. Where I learned how a business runs day to day.
Later, I was the one responsible for the team.
Started my own startup. Still clocked in.
